title: Replace an individual contractor licence
summary: You can apply for a replacement individual contractor licence if your current licence is damaged, lost, or stolen, by visiting a Service NSW Centre.
intro:
If you hold an individual contractor licence and it's been damaged, lost or stolen, you can apply for a replacement licence at a Service NSW Centre.

To check your licence number and details visit Verify NSW.
who_can_apply: Hold an individual contractor licence that is damaged, lost, or stolen.
what_you_need: The PDF form: 'Application for duplicate licence, certificate or permit'

how_to_steps.text: Submit your application and payment at a service centre.

external_links.text: Building, trade and specialist licences and registrations – Building Commission NSW

faqs.q: How can I check my licence number and details?
faqs.a: You can check your licence number and details by visiting Verify NSW.

faqs.q: Where do I submit my application for a replacement licence?
faqs.a: You must submit your application and payment at a Service NSW Centre.
